title: Why Sparrows Bathe in Dust
caption:
DUST OR WATER? House sparrows in a new footage-grounded edit. #WildVox #HouseSparrow #BirdBath

narration_timeline.text: This sparrow rolls in a flowerbed, kicking up dry dust as it bathes.
narration_timeline.scene: Real sparrow rolling in flowerbed dust

narration_timeline.text: Other sparrows do the same on zoo grounds, using tiny shakes to work dust through their feathers.
narration_timeline.scene: Two independent zoo-ground sparrow dust-bath videos

narration_timeline.text: Meanwhile, a female sparrow searches for food among leaves and low plants.
narration_timeline.scene: Actual female sparrow searching ground and plants

narration_timeline.text: One bird perches by a mossy stone border; another appears near a city waterfront.
narration_timeline.scene: One distant sparrow near mossy stone border and separate waterfront sparrow

narration_timeline.text: But another sparrow chooses water, splashing near a pond instead of dry soil.
narration_timeline.scene: Real house sparrow bathing at pond edge

narration_timeline.text: At a shared birdbath, different birds gather, showing how varied this routine can be.
